description: Vogelbuurt-Noord 1918-19 single-storey cottages with a dark tarred-timber band (Zamenhofstraat 6-90, Lange Vogelstraat, Vogelplantsoen): 5.0 m fronts, brick to 3.0 m with a one-metre dark boarded band under a bracketed gutter at 4.1 m, a wide two-light window and a dark door in a pale frame; the doors pair across the party wall; a cream timber box dormer about 3 m wide stands against the party wall on the window side and joins its neighbour's into one 6 m dormer

match.note: BAG 1918-19 on 31 of 31 Zamenhofstraat pands, 3DBAG roof max 6.5-7.2 m (dormers); the strip skyline reads the dormer top at 5.7-6.8 m over the 4.1 m gutter

half-dormer.note: Zamenhofstraat 6-12 (2025-09-22): a cream timber box dormer 3.1 m wide, 4.6-6.0 m, against the party wall on the window side; neighbours' halves join (6.2 m wide over 1.9-8.1 m)

door-right.note: dark single leaf 0.75 m in a pale frame with a transom, at the party wall; the neighbour mirrors it so the doors stand in pairs 1.7 m apart

rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall; dormers and doors pair across it
rhythm.roofline: bracketed gutter, long tiled roof, box dormer per pair

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2025-09-22, 40 px/m, 1 m grid: pands 5.0 m; wide window 2.0 m at 2.0-4.0 m, sill 1.12 m, head 2.44 m; door 0.75 m (0.9 m with frame) at 9.1-10.8 m (a pair across the wall); dark boarded band 3.0-4.0 m; gutter with bracket row 4.1 m; dormer 4.6-6.0 m, 6.2 m wide over the party wall at 5.0 m, five narrow lights; foot of the door 0.5 m over the strip's bottom row

schemaLimits: the 6.2 m dormer is two 3.1 m halves, drawn as one dormer per front
dormer lights are the kit's, not the photo's five narrow lights
brick course under the timber band and the ventilation bricks are not drawn
notes: Palette: brick #8f6a58 is one tone for the buurt, not per pand: strips of one date differ by 2x in exposure (raw brick medians 77-221 on 2025-09-22) and the trim normalisation locks onto hedges and the dark timber band, so measuredWall is off. The tone is the median of the 8 darker-exposed strips (raw 86-105,66-85,58-74) lifted x1.5; a reviewer should pin the row if a photo disagrees. Opus verdict 2026-11-10: photo wall median #554339 (vogel-3-11-r1), so brick moved to #74584a, about 60 % of the way from the lifted figure to the photo.
The timber band colour #2c2b30 is read from Zamenhofstraat 6-12 (the strip's dark boarding), not a type default for other streets.
